eligible_history: Exclude rows where promo_flag or stockout_flag is true.

forecast_methods.stable: Arithmetic mean of the latest 8 eligible observations, repeated for each horizon week.
forecast_methods.trending: OLS line on the latest 13 eligible observations using calendar-week offsets from the first history week; forecast the next 4 calendar weeks and floor at zero.
forecast_methods.seasonal: For each horizon week, use the units from exactly 52 weeks earlier multiplied by the ratio of the latest 8 eligible observations to their eligible 52-week-prior counterparts.
forecast_methods.intermittent: Croston forecast with alpha 0.20 on the latest 26 eligible observations: initialize size to first positive demand and interval to its 1-based position; at each later positive demand update size and positive-to-positive interval with alpha; repeat size/interval for the horizon.

rounding: Keep full precision through calculations; published forecast values may be rounded to 2 decimals and inventory unit quantities must be whole units.
safety_stock: For all SKUs, use the sample standard deviation of the latest 26 eligible weekly demands. SS = ceil(z * sqrt((LT_avg_weeks + review_period_weeks) * sigma_week^2 + mean_forecast_week^2 * LT_std_weeks^2)).
inventory_position: on_hand + quantities on open or confirmed purchase orders - backorders - committed
recommended_order: ceil(max(0, target_stock - inventory_position)) rounded up to a full case; if positive, it must also be at least the SKU MOQ.
pre_arrival_risk: A SKU is at risk when on_hand - backorders - committed plus open/confirmed PO quantities due on or before planning_date + new_lead_time_avg_days is less than mean_forecast_week * LT_avg_weeks.
